instruction.text: Read the texts below and choose the reason for them being split into paragraphs.

atoms.a:
Last year, I could not cook anything. I was always ordering takeaways and wasting money.

Over the summer, I learnt to cook. I eat much healthier food now.

“Careful! You’re going to spill your drink,” exclaimed Tom.

“don’t worry, I have it under control,” said Jerry.

As a teenager, I lived in Asia and it was so beautiful.

These days, I live in the UK. It is much colder here.

“I got the job!” exclaimed Eli.

“Well done! I’m so proud of you,” said Jerry.

instruction.text: Drag the two sentences together that would be in the same paragraph.

atoms.a: My favourite music is rock music.
atoms.b: The atmosphere at a concert is always amazing.

atoms.a: I hate going to the dentist.
atoms.b: I am scared of all the tools they use.
They are so loyal and kind.

instruction.text: Drag the two sentences together that would be in the same paragraph.
Drag the paragraphs into the correct order.

atoms.text: 'La Tomatina' is a famous Spanish tradition that takes place every year in northern Spain.
The festival is essentially a huge food fight. People throw tomatoes at each other and have fun.
This idea for the festival started from a food fight that happened in the streets of the town of Buñol many years ago.
Finally, when the food fight ends, the residents, as well as the streets, are cleaned off by the town’s fire trucks.
